world.title: 2 killed in school shooting in Philippines’ Zamboanga, gunman among casualties
world.summary: A high school student in Zamboanga, Philippines, shot and killed a fellow student before taking his own life on a university campus. The incident occurred on Tuesday, resulting in two fatalities. The shooter was armed with two firearms. Authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the tragedy, which has raised concerns about school safety in the region.

world.title: Pentagon official warns of regional nuclear war
world.summary: A senior Pentagon official, Elbridge Colby, has warned that a regional conflict involving the use of nuclear weapons could lead to a wider escalation, posing a greater threat than a surprise mass attack on the United States. He emphasized the risks of localized nuclear warfare and its potential to spiral into broader hostilities, increasing global security concerns.

world.title: South China Morning Post
world.summary: Global shipping disruptions and oil and gas projects have increased the strategic importance of the Northern Sea Route. Houthi attacks on commercial vessels in the Red Sea have further complicated maritime traffic, impacting the Suez Canal, the quickest passage between Europe and Asia. This situation marks the most significant conflict-related disruption since the Arab-Israeli war decades ago.

business.title: Trade Spotlight: How should you trade Muthoot Finance, Cummins India, Bata India, IFCI, Paras Defence, Shriram Finance, and others on August 18?
business.summary: Equity benchmarks experienced selling pressure for the fifth consecutive session, declining over 0.3% on August 17. Analysts suggest that Monday's low may be at risk as range-bound trading persists. Short-term trading ideas for Muthoot Finance, Cummins India, Bata India, IFCI, Paras Defence, and Shriram Finance are provided, highlighting potential weak links in portfolios for traders to consider.

business.title: Biggest US grid operator has a ‘shutdown proposal’ that shows tension between data centers and power grids in America
business.summary: PJM Interconnection, the largest electrical grid operator in the US, has proposed a framework mandating data centers to switch to backup generators when regional power reserves are critically low. This proposal highlights the ongoing tension between the growing demand for data center energy and the stability of power grids across America, aiming to ensure reliable electricity supply during peak demand.

business.title: Milky Mist Dairy Food shares list at 18% premium over IPO price
business.summary: Milky Mist Dairy Food shares debuted at Rs 165 on the NSE and BSE, an 18% premium over the IPO price of Rs 140. The Rs 1,553-crore issue saw significant demand, with overall subscription reaching 56.12 times. Qualified Institutional Buyers (QIB) showed strong interest, subscribing 155.83 times, while the retail portion was subscribed 8.41 times.

technology.title: Elden Ring Switch 2 performance improves in new videos, but may fall below 30 fps
technology.summary: Elden Ring's Tarnished Edition is set to release on August 28 for the Switch 2, but new footage raises concerns about performance. While visuals appear more consistent, docked mode offers limited improvements, and frame rates in handheld mode may drop below 30 fps. Developers are under pressure to optimize the game before its impending launch.

technology.title: Microsoft admits Windows 11 context menus are sluggish, announces major improvements
technology.summary: Microsoft has acknowledged that context menus in Windows 11 are slow and is set to implement significant enhancements. The updates will introduce a more customizable and streamlined layout, aimed at improving speed when opening these menus in File Explorer and on the desktop. These changes are part of ongoing efforts to enhance user experience in Windows 11.

technology.title: iPhone Ultra leakers reveal new details around release and 'extremely limited' availability
technology.summary: Leaks indicate that Apple's upcoming foldable iPhone, rumored to be named iPhone Ultra or iPhone Fold, is set for unveiling at the September event. However, its availability at launch is expected to be "extremely limited." The device has generated significant anticipation, with details emerging from reputable sources ahead of the official announcement.

sports.title: England youngster reveals Virat Kohli’s lasting impact: ‘He’s always at the end of phone’
sports.summary: An English cricketer preparing for his Test debut has highlighted the influence of Virat Kohli, who has been a source of guidance. The player recalled valuable advice received from Kohli during their time together, emphasizing the Indian star's ongoing support. Although he did not disclose all details of their conversations, the young cricketer appreciates Kohli's mentorship.

sports.title: 'He’s unbelievable' - Michael Owen tells Man Utd they should have signed £60m Chelsea star Joao Pedro
sports.summary: Michael Owen stated that Manchester United should have signed Joao Pedro from Watford prior to his £60 million transfer to Chelsea. He praised Pedro's talent and predicted a successful season for Xabi Alonso. Owen, a former striker for Manchester United and Liverpool, believes the Red Devils missed an opportunity to acquire the Brazilian before he gained prominence at Chelsea.

sports.title: Report: Barcelona’s captaincy order for 2026/27 as two new players enter hierarchy
sports.summary: FC Barcelona winger Raphinha has reportedly been named the first captain for the 2026/27 season. While official confirmation is pending, the report indicates a five-man captaincy group for the upcoming campaign. This change marks the introduction of two new players into the leadership hierarchy, reflecting the club's strategic adjustments as they prepare for the new season.

health.title: Tuesday Special: Ameera Shah On India’s Preventative Testing Boom
health.summary: Preventive health testing is gaining popularity in India, prompting discussions about which tests are essential and which may lead to unnecessary expenses or anxiety. In a special feature, expert insights are shared to clarify these trends and help individuals make informed decisions about their health. The aim is to enhance understanding of the evolving landscape of preventive healthcare in India.

health.title: Viral Hepatitis Deaths Increase Worldwide Despite Prevention Efforts
health.summary: Chronic hepatitis B-related deaths rose by 17% since 2015, making up most viral hepatitis fatalities in 2024, according to the 2026 World Health Organization (WHO) Global Hepatitis Report. This increase occurred despite advancements in hepatitis B vaccination and hepatitis C treatment. The report serves as the first assessment of progress in combating viral hepatitis globally.

health.title: AI could bridge the women’s health gap, but better data is the key
health.summary: Women’s health research has been historically underprioritized, leading to significant individual and societal consequences. This neglect results in unpredictable health outcomes for women globally. Experts suggest that artificial intelligence could help address these disparities, but emphasize the necessity for improved data to effectively bridge the gap in women’s health. Better data is crucial for informed research and treatment advancements.

science.title: Cosmic beauty born from a dying star revealed in stunning telescope images
science.summary: NASA's James Webb Telescope has captured new images of the Lion Nebula, showcasing its vibrant features. Scientists predict the nebula will disperse in approximately 10,000 years. Within its "mane," hazy comet-shaped objects have been identified, adding to the nebula's complexity. These stunning visuals provide valuable insights into the life cycle of dying stars and their cosmic formations.

science.title: Pesticides make Argentine ants go crazy, sending them roaming or clustering before workers die
science.summary: Research from UC Riverside indicates that pesticide exposure alters the behavior of Argentine ants, causing them to roam or cluster before worker ants die. An increase in ant activity following pesticide application does not necessarily indicate treatment failure, as the chemicals affect the colony's dynamics. Understanding these behavioral changes is crucial for effective pest management strategies.

science.title: Labrador Sea a key player in providing oxygen for deep North Atlantic life
science.summary: Researchers from Cornell University have identified the Labrador Sea as a crucial source of oxygen for deep-sea life in the North Atlantic Ocean. The study, published in Nature Geoscience on August 17, highlights the importance of the churning waters in this region for sustaining marine ecosystems. This discovery enhances understanding of oceanic processes and their impact on marine biodiversity.

entertainment.title: Sonu Nigam's intellectual property suit resolved by Bombay High Court as the singer's namesake agrees to not use his identity, image without authorisation
entertainment.summary: The Bombay High Court resolved a legal dispute involving singer Sonu Nigam and a namesake who used his identity on social media. The court ruled that the namesake must refrain from using Nigam's likeness or identity without authorization. This decision addresses concerns over intellectual property rights and the unauthorized use of personal branding in digital spaces.

entertainment.title: Sunny Deol says even with Rs 55.99 crore debt when bank issued auction notice for his Juhu home, he was happy: 'I didn’t owe anyone anything, I just had to sell my own assets'
entertainment.summary: Sunny Deol revealed he faced a challenging financial period before the success of 'Gadar 2,' accumulating a debt of Rs 55.99 crore. When a bank auction notice was issued for his Juhu home, he expressed contentment, stating he owed nothing to others and only needed to sell his own assets. This phase preceded his career revival.

entertainment.title: Anirudh Ravichander and Kavya Maran to marry in Greece? Wedding dates locked for post Diwali - Report
entertainment.summary: Anirudh Ravichander and Kavya Maran are reportedly set to marry in Greece, with wedding dates scheduled for after Diwali. The rumors have resurfaced, attracting interest from both entertainment and sports communities. This speculation has been intensified by a recent report, suggesting that the couple is planning a destination wedding, although official confirmations are yet to be made.
